text: HSBC reports $29.91B annual pre-tax profit, down 7.4% year on year, with revenue up 4% to $68.27B, both above estimates. Operating expenses increase 8% amid restructuring and technology costs. Hang Seng privatization completed; payroll cost reduction target near 8% with managing director roles reduced 15%.

meta.note: One-off disposal gains affect quarterly comparison; headcount targets not fully specified.

text: David Tepper of Appaloosa Management sends letter to Whirlpool's board opposing recent equity and depositary share offerings totaling roughly $963 million. Whirlpool shares fall 14% following secondary sale. Letter references capital structure, dilution, and fiduciary responsibilities while board governance remains intact.

meta.note: Activist pressure present; no board response or governance change announced at time logged.

text: Larry Summers states he will retire from his Harvard professorship at the end of the academic year and remain on leave until then. University review of documents related to Jeffrey Epstein is ongoing. Leadership role at Harvard Kennedy School previously relinquished; no criminal charges reported.

meta.note: Resignation intersects with institutional review; scope of findings not disclosed at time logged.
